propositions: pip-audit gating job fails on every patchset against main because click 8.2.1 in uv.lock contains PYSEC-2026-2132 command injection vulnerability
inspect-ai dependency pins click to versions <8.2.2, blocking any lock upgrade to 8.3.3 or higher via standard constraint mechanisms
uv resolves all extras jointly, so removing inspect-ai from [eval] extra or overriding its click cap are the only paths to bump click in the lock
The click vulnerability is unreachable in rebar because click is transitive only via inspect-ai and rebar never calls click.edit()
Using uv override-dependencies to force click>=8.3.3 resolves the locked click version to 8.4.2 while keeping inspect-ai present and functional
